steps: Open the Songkick home route at the frozen desktop viewport.
Use primary navigation and browse nearby concerts without remote runtime requests.
Browse the frozen concert, artist, festival, regional and leaderboard collections.
Use represented pagination, date and genre controls while remaining local.
Open every frozen event, artist, venue and festival detail identity.
Inspect its source-grounded identity, metadata, related items and local links.
Open global search and enter Coldplay to receive the frozen deterministic results.
Enter the frozen no-result term and receive the captured no-results state.
Create a local account, sign in, refresh, sign out and sign back in.
Request password recovery through the local outbox without production delivery.
Track and untrack an artist and mark or unmark an event as interested or attended.
Verify account-scoped mutations across refresh, logout, relogin and restart.
Load all in-scope pages and assets from loopback only.
Observe zero production source requests and zero production side effects.
Activate each frozen external destination identity.
Land on a branded local HTTP 200 soft-404 that names the destination without contacting it.
Open an unknown first-party route.
Receive the captured branded HTTP 404 and use its local recovery controls.
Change the represented location, appearance, locale and cookie preferences.
Verify each preference remains local and persists according to its browser/account scope.
